project: One Dot Coffee Shop - Premium Brand Website

body.style: tracking-wide for small labels (tracking-[0.2em]), leading-relaxed for body.

typography.rules: H1 max size is text-6xl. Use explicit weights (font-light or font-black) to avoid default bold. For bilingual support, use HTML 'dir' attribute and conditionally swap font families based on language.

colors.rules: Never use pure black #000000. Tint backgrounds with a warm coffee hue (#12100E). Use Gold sparingly for CTAs, lines, and active states.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Glassmorphism with heavy blur (backdrop-blur-2xl) and a delicate 1px border (border-white/10). Solid flat backgrounds for cards with no drop-shadows, just 1px border-white/5.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain overlay across the entire site to prevent digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Hovering on cards should slightly lift them and increase border opacity from 5% to 15%.

layouts.hero: Full screen (h-screen) with a dark cinematic image. Overlay: bg-black/40. Stats placed at the bottom.
layouts.menu_bento: Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Each product card has a large top image (h-64 object-cover) and text below. No traditional text-only lists.
layouts.signature: Massive images spanning at least col-span-2 in a grid, or full viewport height sticky sections. Massive typography numbering '01', '02', '03'.
layouts.gallery: Horizontal scrolling container (overflow-x-auto snap-x) with hide-scrollbar class. Images should be tall and cinematic.
layouts.location: Bento style. Large map spanning 2 columns, address and hours in 1 column.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full). Primary: bg-[#D4AF37] text-black hover:bg-[#B59530]. Secondary/Outline: border border-white/20 text-[#F4F0EB] hover:bg-white/10.
components.tabs: For menu categories. Use Shadcn Tabs but strip default background. Active tab gets a gold underline or text color change.
components.modal: For product details. Use Shadcn Dialog. Custom styling: dark background, 1px border, large hero image inside the modal, ingredient lists.
components.sticky_bar: Mobile only. Fixed bottom-0 w-full glassmorphism background. 3 equal-width buttons (Menu, Location, Order) with Phosphor icons.

motion.intro: A single small gold dot center screen. It grows, morphs into 'ONE DOT' logo, then 'Find your moment.' fades in. Afterwards, the hero section reveals.
motion.scroll: Use Framer Motion for scroll reveals (fade up, slow). Recommend Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.micro: Hovering images slowly scales them up (scale-105) within an overflow-hidden container. Star rating pulses subtly.

hero.description: White and gold teacup with dark cinematic vibe.

signature_2.description: Coffee capsule with red and gold stripes.

barista.description: Barista working in a dark setting.

menu_hot.description: Clear glass cup on espresso machine.

menu_cold.description: Iced coffee in a tall glass.

menu_matcha.description: Matcha latte with swan latte art.

menu_dessert.description: Chocolate cakes on a dark plate.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over images has sufficient contrast. Use gradient overlays (from-black/70 to-transparent) if text must go over a busy image part.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using React and TailwindCSS. Follow this JSON strictly.
Use Framer Motion for the initial Dot-to-Logo animation. Cover the viewport, dot scales up, logo fades in, then screen transitions out.
Implement bilingual support. Use a state or context for English/Arabic, and toggle the `dir` attribute on the HTML or main container (`ltr` / `rtl`). Use appropriate Arabic fonts for `rtl`.
Create the separate Admin Dashboard. It should have a login screen and simple protected routes to manage the menu items. Use a dense grid layout for the admin.
Use Phosphor icons for all icons.
Do not center everything. Align text to the left/right depending on RTL/LTR.
For the Mobile Sticky Bar, fix it to the bottom on md and smaller screens. Hide it on desktop.
Make the WhatsApp button prominent in the Order section, linking to 'https://wa.me/...'
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, tabs, and form inputs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic, centered layouts, or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts (located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx, if available).
